listing.name: Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure — tsapZ SSARecomp (tsapZ)
listing.summary: Chapter 1 is reported to work. Later sections and installation on a clean machine have not been tested. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 ISO or extracted folder with the region-free 10-language executable for title 415608AB. The accepted default.xex fingerprint is e195f5130c1e23fb4654baf7c383ef97d02c89aeb7d4389705ae31235646ef7b.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release installer and import your own ISO. Games run as standalone native programs. The CoreOfLight hub and a real USB portal are optional; a virtual portal is supported. The Windows x64 player uses D3D12. Building from source requires VS2022 Clang, CMake, Ninja, just and Python.

warnings: Chapter 1 is reported to work. Later sections and installation on a clean machine have not been tested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
